name: Sutherland Spaceport

overview.value: Sutherland spaceport, also known as Space Hub Sutherland or UK Vertical Launch (UKVL) Sutherland, is a planned spaceport in Sutherland, Scotland, intended to be one of the first vertical launch capable spaceports in the United Kingdom and operated by a commercial entity. In December 2024, Orbex announced that construction of the spaceport had been put on indefinite hold, with the first Prime launches to be conducted from SaxaVord Spaceport instead.
